# MediaPipe canonical face template

Source: google-ai-edge/mediapipe
Upstream blob: 0e666d1c4e75949d1639c2bcf347a38da4834164
Path: mediapipe/modules/face_geometry/data/canonical_face_model.obj
License: Apache-2.0

This file is the semantic 3-D face template used by the MARS fitting tools.
It is an authority for landmark indices and feature topology, not a replacement
for the MARS identity mesh. Visual acceptance still requires real MARS renders.
